name: PostHog Free
free_limit: PostHog Free: 1M product analytics events/month, 5,000 session recordings/month and 1M feature-flag requests/month
watch_out: The $0 Free plan has no credit-card requirement and renews monthly; quotas are independent per product. Without billing enabled, excess events are dropped and feature flags fall back to quota-limited behavior; adding a card moves to usage-based billing with paid overages. Free plan allows one project and one-year retention.
